claims.claim: Two bass players are connected to the song and it is presented as a bass play-along.
claims.assessment: Album personnel credit Larry Junstrom on bass, and the band history lists Larry Steele as the first-lineup bassist. Both are stated in the description.

claims.claim: Larry Junstrom is the bass player on the record.
claims.assessment: Tour de Force personnel list Larry Junstrom on bass, and the song is track one on that album.

claims.claim: Larry Steele held the bass in the band's first lineup and is one of the four writers.
claims.assessment: The band history lists Steele in the 1974 lineup. The song infobox credits Barnes, Carlisi, Steele and Van Zant as songwriters.

claims.claim: Steele left almost straight away and came back as the group's stage manager.
claims.assessment: The band history says he dropped out almost immediately, was replaced by Ken Lyons, and later returned as the group's stage manager.

claims.claim: His writing credit sits beside Barnes, Carlisi and Donnie Van Zant.
claims.assessment: The songwriter list matches the song infobox exactly.

claims.claim: The upload runs four minutes ten.
claims.assessment: The player duration reads 4:10. The single is 3:55, so the copy gives the upload length and never claims to be the single edit.

claims.claim: Requests run on Kick, the broadcast mirrors to Twitch, and Discord hosts Southern rock discussion.
claims.source: Standing channel practice in existing copy
claims.assessment: House order, Kick then Twitch then Discord, one URL each. No schedule asserted.

claims.claim: A viewer comment from @blaze_the_bassist is pinned and is not replaced.
claims.source: Studio comments screenshot in this folder
claims.assessment: The marker line records the live text with two creator replies under it. The agent does not edit or unpin it, and the creator comment is posted separately.

claims.claim: Quiz: which Georgia studio hosted the Tour de Force sessions in 1983? Options are Studio One, The Castle and Muscle Shoals Sound.
claims.assessment: Answer A, Studio One in Doraville, Georgia, given in the album infobox. The other two are real studios used only as distractors, and none of the three is named in the description.

claims.claim: Dedicated play-along, routed to the Rocksmith 2014 Bass Play Along playlist rather than the genre or All Genres lists.
claims.source: User standing rule, recorded in Ver 3.0/TXT/Play_Along_Series_ID_Map.md
claims.assessment: The playlist field shows one Play Along list. The user reports genres added, which conflicts with the rule and the screenshot; recorded, not resolved.

distinct_fact_and_source: The two bass players behind the record: Larry Junstrom on bass, and Larry Steele, the first-lineup bassist who became the band's stage manager, co-writing it. Unused by any other .38 Special upload and unrelated to the MCR, Green Day and Motionless In White sets. Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tour_de_Force_(38_Special_album) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/38_Special_(band) ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/If_I%27d_Been_the_One
uniqueness_assessment: Zero five-word phrases shared with any other package once the song title is set aside, checked against the whole accessible copy corpus. Two rounds of rewriting were needed: the first draft collided with existing wording on the note highway line and on the call-to-action lines.
uncertainties_and_removed_claims: The upload is 4:10 against a 3:55 single, so no claim is made that it is the single edit. The playlist screenshot shows only the Play Along list while the user reports genres added; both are recorded. The studio is deliberately kept out of the description so the quiz answer is not printed. Live comments are historical and no Studio action was taken.
